name: Tsuge Eufinley
source:
Younger version of Eufinley, in the first chapters she is introduced as [url=/c39744]Phoron[/url]'s senior at the academy. Despite her still being a high school student, she is already a member of the Tsuge Divine Music Player Office where she plays a violin-like instrument. Eufinley is described to be a genius girl with outstanding qualities. 

[Combined descriptions from [url=http://ocelot.product.co.jp/products/poli1/polyphonica.htm#chara]official website[/url] and [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Shinkyoku_S%C5%8Dkai_Polyphonica_characters]Wikipedia[/url].]
